Zhang Marlfur is a pandaren farmer found in Stoneplow, in the Valley of the Four Winds. When told to evacuate Marlfur refused, stating that his family would stay to protect their land and that his grandfather knew what the potential danger was in starting a farm near the Serpent's Spine. He is killed by the attacking mantid, and his gravestone can be found near his home, being guarded by his children.
Zhi Marlfur is a pandaren child located at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Zhang Yue is a pandaren at Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Zhu's Watch Courier is a deceased pandaren found at the Incursion in Krasarang Wilds. He originated from Zhu's Watch.

Zhu's Descent runs from the Yan-Zhe River down to Zhu Province in Krasarang Wilds on the eastern end of Valley of the Four Winds, south of the Thunderfoot Fields. The Rumbling Terrace can be found further west.

Zhu's Watch is the main settlement of Zhu Province in northeast Krasarang Wilds. The village was built centuries ago by Zhu Longbrow and his family, because he was tired of the needless loss of life that happened in the dangerous wilds by pandaren on their way to the red crane's temple. The residents have a unique custom, in that they consider the greatest gift one can give to a good friend is a tree, because a tree represents peace, growth, and life. It is a blessing of friendship.

Zhu Province is the pandaren-claimed territory in northeastern Krasarang Wilds. Zhu's Watch stands watch near its center preventing wild creatures from leaving the jungles into the Valley of the Four Winds. The town makes sure all three memorial fires stay lit, near the border, which generally keeps the beasts at bay. The province is also home to two ponds that have currently been drained by the sha energies and created elementals from the water and salt. There's a small unnamed cave to the north claimed by the Wildscale saurok.
Zhang Oxfoot is a pandaren located at the Jade Temple Grounds in the Jade Forest.
Zhi-Zhi is a hozen located at Tian Monastery in Jade Forest. He is a monk at the monastery and is one of the best fighters who has won several spares.
Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter is the leader of the Shao-Tien mogu invading the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He is eventually killed during the Shao-Tien's final assault to capture the Vale.
__NOTOC__ Zephyrus is an unbound air elemental, imprisoned at Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Zhul'dar was a troll working with Havoc the Heartless and killed by Nori Blackfinger.

Zian is a draenei shaman of the Alliance located at the Lunarfall Inn in , where he can be recruited by using the Headhunter's Harvest.

Zhang Yeoh is a pandaren located at Lunarfall and Frostwall. She is added outside the Town Hall as a result of the quest Black Marketeering and provides a real-time view of the items currently listed on the Black Market Auction House in Dalaran or Zuldazar. You will still need to visit Madam Goya to place a bid. The real reason she was sent is so that she can act as Madam Goya's eyes and ears inside the garrison, having failed beforehand to sneak a spy inside.

Zekhan is a jungle troll shaman who participated in the Battle for Lordaeron. He is the son of Hekazi, who fought in the Third War alongside Varok Saurfang. His father told him tales about Saurfang and how he could slaughter ten enemies with a single blow. Zekhan eventually joined the Horde's war effort. He later became a companion of Varok Saurfang into his self-imposed exile; acting as one of the few Saurfang trusted during that time. He remained at the High Overlord's side until Saurfang's death, inspired to carry on his legacy. He later became a Horde ambassador in Zandalar.

Zeb'ahari is a fishing village in eastern Zuldazar. There are trained ankylodons patrolling the area. The village was built around Jol the Ancient. After Zul's coup, King Rastakhan is brought to the village to be healed. Loa-Speaker Kihara betrayed the village to the Atal'zul.

Zerek, Master Cloner is a ethereal who works for . Giving him the resources he needs, his field of work is cloning. He has an assistant called Test Subject #362. He shares his assistants with Stargazer Luna, something he is not happy about. He created Robo-Boom a clone of Dr. Boom with a robot brain.

Zenbaro is a Zandalari troll sitting in front of a campfire on a terrace in southeastern Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun. He offers to tell his tragic life story to the player if they repeatedly bring him water from the nearby Eternal Spring.

Zenbaro's Empty Canteen is provided through dialogue with Zenbaro in Vol'dun. In order to progress through Zenbaro's conversations, the player must use the canteen within one of the bodies of water at the Eternal Spring, turning it into Zenbaro's Canteen, which they can then bring back to Zenbaro.
Zenbaro's Canteen is created by filling Zenbaro's Empty Canteen — provided through dialogue with Zenbaro — with water from the Eternal Spring in Vol'dun.
Zenbaro's Lockbox is found in the back of a building in the Village in the Vines in Zuldazar. It can only be opened after the player completes the dialogues with Zenbaro in Vol'dun.

Zelmany is a lich located on the Rotting Mound in Maldraxxus.

Zereth Mortis is the forbidden realm of the First Ones, tucked away in the fabric of the Shadowlands itself. It was crafted by the First Ones to act as their workshop and is intended to create afterlives, a process carried out by the enormous Forge of Afterlives floating at the center of the realm. A race of mechanical caretakers called the automa were left behind by the First Ones to facilitate this process. The realm's most notable feature is the Sepulcher of the First Ones, which contains knowledge that could rewrite reality. The Zephyreal Generator is provided by Elder Nirav for Bzzzzt! to be used on Vespoid Nests in Zereth Mortis.

The Zereth Mortis campaign covers the storylines added in patch 9.2 as the concluding portion of the overarching Shadowlands campaign, tracked in the achievements Secrets of the First Ones and From A to Zereth. The quests take place almost exclusively in the new zone of Zereth Mortis.

The Zoram'gar Outpost (or the Zoram Strand Outpost) is a Horde port outpost located on the Zoram Strand of Ashenvale. It was heavily expanded and reinforced at some point before or during the Cataclysm, resembling the orcish outposts of Northrend. Its port section is named the Zoram'gar Docks. It may have been rebuilt after an Alliance attack that happened when Garrosh attacked Ashenvale and Alliance sent reinforcements to the forest. Since the Siege of Orgrimmar, the Horde didn't use the outpost much, and was entirely abandoned by the time the War of the Thorns kicked off, even being referred to as ruins. Zilzibin Drumlore is a jungle troll quest giver located in the Mighty Pen shop in the upper level of the Drag in Orgrimmar. He can be seen speaking with Nerog.

Zjolnir is a jungle troll raptor vendor located in Sen'jin Village in Durotar. Zjolnir accompanied the Darkspear Rebellion in retaking of Razor Hill. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.

Zixil is a goblin speciality vendor located on the path between Tarren Mill and Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He can also be found in the tower near Tarren Mill with his robotic guardian Overwatch Mark I. Zixil can also be found in the Caverns of Time dungeon Old Hillsbrad at the Southshore docks, finishing building his first robotic guardian, an Overwatch Mark 0. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Zikkel is a goblin banker located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He carries a brown bag and a red bag. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.

Zizzek is a goblin fishing vendor located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He resides outside of the Broken Keel Tavern. He was critically wounded during the Legion invasions, but an adventurer saved his life.
The purpose of these lists is to help players to pick a region for questing.

Zombie Chows are zombies found during the Gluth encounter in Naxxramas. They must be kited until Gluth reduces their health with Decimate, and then quickly killed before Gluth eats them to restore his health.
Zudd is an orc pet trainer located in Grom'Gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

The Ziata'jai Ruinsare ancient Troll ruins inhabited by the Skullsplitter tribe. It is located north of Fort Livingston. During the events of the Rise of Zandalari, the place was invaded by Jungle Serpents.
Zul'Brin Warpbranch is a rare forest troll found in Zul'Mashar in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Zora is a rare silithid wasp found in Hive'Zora in Silithus. She is likely the queen of the hive, as evidenced by her name.
__NOTOC__ Zolo was a Jungle troll ghost once found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.

:Where you looking for the weapon, The Ziggler? Ziggler was a goblin tinker. He traveled to the hut of the witch doctor Zul'ajik, along with his companions the blood elf Maer-thiss, and the dwarf Gimbolt Surehammer. They visited the troll in order to hire him to perform a ritual to contact spirits which would lead to the Demonwell. Because of Zul'ajik's hatred for goblins, Ziggler chose to stay outside of the camp, and to tinker on his clockwork dwarf. While under the influence of blue mushrooms, Ziggler interrupted the ritual when he piloted the clockwork dwarf through the camp and trampled both the troll's tent and Maer-thiss. Zim the Mad, a tinker, was building a boning machine to prepare his favorite dish: Gefilte human. He created a charming sketch of a conveyor belt system with thirty-six strategically placed blades. It is a complex repetitive chore, but the blades are positioned efficiently, and will do the job quickly within minutes.

Patch 2.3 gave players sets of similar armor types sharing the same models but with different stats for another spec or class. The items had stats and mods like armor penetration and haste which were previously only available to those in Tier 6 content. They have been referred to as Tier 5.5 by some since their ilvl fell in between T5 and T6 quality gear. These sets are gotten either through drops in Zul'Aman or are purchased from G'eras in Shattrath with . These sets do not offer class-exclusive bonuses and some items are also desired by different classes and armor types.
Ziggurat Protectors were undead ghouls that could be found in the Eastern Plaguelands, one in each of the Plaguewood ziggurats.
Zivlix is a goblin quest giver found at Nozzlerust Post in the Dragonblight.
Zort is a goblin quest giver found in the Crystal Vice of the Dragonblight.
Zort's Scraper is provided as an onjective for Messy Business.
Zort's Protective Elixir is provided as an objective for Apply This Twice A Day.
Ziggurat Defenders are plague eruptors located at the Wailing Ziggurat in the Borean Tundra.
Zim'Abwa is a small area focused around the neglected statue of the troll god Zim'Abwa which accepts Drakkari Offerings in exchange for a blessing.
Zol'Maz Stronghold Caches can be found at Zol'Maz Stronghold in Zul'Drak.

A Zippelin is a toy zeppelin, made by engineers, although players cannot make them at this time. These mechanical devices float around and are usually equipped with some form of launcher on its front.
Zul'Drak is a level 20-30 zone in Northrend. The Progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement The Empire of Zul'Drak.

Zim'Torga is a neutral troll encampment controlled by the Zandalari, located between the Argent Stand and Gundrak in Zul'Drak. The outpost sits in a small clearing in the middle of a tightly grown stand of thorny trees that make a natural wall. In the center of the outpost is a statue of the goddess Zim'Torga, the Mother of Prosperity, which accepts Drakkari Offerings for a blessing. It is an outpost of the Zandalari trolls, who came to the region not to help their cousins but to bear witness to the Drakkari Empire's fall at the time of the war against the Lich King. The Zombie Infestation, or Zombie Plague, is the world event sparked one week after patch 3.0.2 immediately preceding the release of Wrath of the Lich King. It was followed by the second Scourge Invasion and Death Rising.
__NOTOC__ Zom's Crackling Bulwark is a rare drop in Northrend.
Zombiefest! is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for killing 100 Risen Zombies in 1 minute in the Culling of Stratholme on Heroic difficulty.
Zul'Drak Bats are bats found between the Argent Stand and the Altar of Sseratus in Zul'Drak.
Zom Bocom is a goblin PvP rewards vendor. He can be found in the Underbelly of Dalaran and is usable by both Horde and Alliance. He sells last season's gear in exchange for Honor Points.

Zim'Rhuk is a small area in central Zul'Drak just northeast of the Amphitheater of Anguish. The primary focus of the area is the neglected statue of the troll god Zim'Rhuk, "The Wise One". Zim'Rhuk is also known to be very protective of his domain, he maintains guardians that deal harshly with anyone that does not have the wits to slip past them.

Zol'Maz Stronghold is a stone fortress in northeastern Zul'Drak patrolled by Enchanted Tiki Warriors who guard the many hex-guarded Zol'Maz Stronghold Caches. It is an impressive fortress with a bloody, dark story to go with it. Hearing of the adventurers exploits in the region, the Drakkari warlord, Zol'Maz, retreated to the stronghold to protect his family. But Zol'Maz also had the key that could free the last surviving loa Akali, so the loa Har'koa sent adventurers after it. To get past the enchanted guards and into the stronghold, they had to kill Zol'Maz's entire family, then him, as he raged over their deaths. The Zul'Drak Sentinel is a rare elite drakkari golem that patrols the roads near The Argent Stand in Zul'Drak.
__NOTOC__ Zul'Drak Rats are critters native to Drak'Agal in Zul'Drak.
The Zodiac Leggings can be looted from the Gift of the Observer after defeating Algalon the Observer in the 10-man version of Ulduar.

ZoneDiscovery is a channel shown in News From Outland: Crisis at Da Portal! movie. When the video is shown the program is "Murlocs in the Mist" and the following program "Exploring the Ruins of the Highborne". The unnamed investigator tells that the murlocs are fascinating creatures and the leader of that group is Gurgles, then Gurgles attack the investigator and the video cuts to show the Gnomeregan Gnews Gnetwork.
Zol'Heb is a building found in Zul'Drak, southeast of Gundrak. This is where adventurers help Har'koa kill the Prophet of Akali.

__NOTOC__ Zor'be the Bloodletter is a jungle troll quest giver located on the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He is affiliated with the Knights of the Ebon Blade. During Death Rising, he was defending the grounds.
There is no player-obtainable raw gem named Zircon, so there are no craftable designs for them. However, there are a number of cut zircon gems available from vendors.
Zukk'ash Workers are silithid workers found at the Writhing Deep in Feralas.
Zukk'ash Tunnelers are silithid workers found at the Writhing Deep in Feralas.
Zukk'ash Stingers are silithid workers found at the Writhing Deep in Feralas.
Zim'bo's Hideout is the large hut in the village of Zeb'Halak found in Grizzly Hills. Warlord Zim'bo is hiding here.
Zod's Repeating Longbow drops from Lady Deathwhisper in the 25-man version of Icecrown Citadel.
Zinge's Purchase Order is provided as an objective for Errand for Apothecary Zinge.

The Zin'jatar are a group of naga found in Kelp'thar Forest which attack both Horde and Alliance forces after Ozumat sinks the ship carrying them. The adventurer is saved by the intervention of Erunak Stonespeaker, who aids them in battling the naga and in time the player is able to reunite with their leaders. Under the direction of their superiors and at the request of members of the Earthen Ring adventurers take the fight to the Zin'jatar and kill their leader. They appear to be one of the three castes in Vashj'ir, likely focusing on battle and raiding.
Zul'Farrak Dead Heroes have a chance to spawn when you try to loot Shallow Graves in Zul'Farrak.
Zim'Torga Defenders are ice elementals captured by the Zandalari trolls in Zim'Torga, Zul'Drak. They help defend the area from the nearby Drakkari ice trolls.

Zido Helmbreaker is a goblin blacksmithing vendor located at Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara. He used to reside in Goblin Slums of Orgrimmar, but was moved to Azshara following the construction of Orgrimmar Embassy. He can still be seen there before allied races are unlocked. He is likely related to Kark Helmbreaker, the blacksmithing trainer.

__NOTOC__ Zoey Wizzlespark is one of Archmage Xylem's apprentices located at the Arcane Pinnacle in Azshara. When a player completes one of the trials, Zoey will congratulate them. Additionally, she sells enchanting supplies though not marked as such.
Zugra Flamefist is holding the portal to Tol Barad from Orgrimmar at the Western Earthshrine.
Zim Bamzabble is an engineering and mining supplies vendor found in the Dragonmaw Port of the Twilight Highlands.
